rabbi-abba.name: Rabbi Abba
rabbi-abba.era: Amora · Babylonia and the Land of Israel, 3rd–4th century
rabbi-abba.bio: Babylonian-born Amora who studied under Rav Huna and Rav Yehuda and then settled in the Land of Israel.
rabbi-abba.prompt: A determined scholar in his 40s with a dark, slightly travel-worn beard, who left Babylonia for the Land of Israel against his teacher’s wishes. Plain brown wool mantle over a linen robe, a traveler’s staff at his shoulder. Limestone arches and olive trees softly behind him.

rabbi-yochanan-ben-beroka.name: Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Beroka
rabbi-yochanan-ben-beroka.bio: Tanna of the generation of Yavne, a student of Rabbi Yehoshua and father of the Tanna Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Beroka.
rabbi-yochanan-ben-beroka.prompt: A thoughtful scholar in his 50s with a greying brown beard and a composed, attentive face. Undyed wool robe and a cream mantle. The Yavne study hall, with limestone columns and soft daylight, behind him.

rav-sheshet.name: Rav Sheshet
rav-sheshet.bio: Babylonian Amora, blind, famed for his vast command of baraitot.
rav-sheshet.prompt: A sturdy, sharp-witted man in his 60s with a full grey beard and his eyes gently closed, for he was blind; his face is alert, as if listening closely. Dark wool robes and a simple mantle. Mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps behind him.

rav-chama.name: Rav Ḥama
rav-chama.bio: Babylonian Amora; on this daf he applies a verse from Ecclesiastes to Rav Sheshet.
rav-chama.prompt: A wry, observant scholar in his 50s with a trimmed dark beard flecked with grey and a faint knowing smile. Ochre wool robe under a dark mantle. Palm groves along the Euphrates softly behind him.

ravin.name: Ravin
ravin.bio: Rabbi Avin, one of the sages who carried the teachings of the Land of Israel to Babylonia; the Gemara introduces his reports with “when Ravin came.”
ravin.prompt: A lean, energetic traveler-scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and a dusty travel cloak over his robes, a leather satchel of notes at his side. A road between the Galilean hills and the Euphrates plain, softly blurred, behind him.
